Build passes now (exit 0). Two real bugs from the bump, both in the link stage:

- `src/core/options.js:6` — the bump renamed the options field `retries` → `retryCount`; this call site still read `options.retries`, so it threw on `undefined.toFixed()`. Now reads `retryCount` with a fallback to `retries`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, and the strict boolean check threw on it. Unset now means off (pre-bump default); non-boolean values still throw.

The remaining 8 warnings are genuine noise — deprecated APIs the bump flagged (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, `punycode`, `crypto.createCipher`), plus an unused export and a `src/core/graph.js ↔ src/state/tracker.js` circular import. None break the build. The circular import is the one worth a follow-up since its resolution order is undefined; say the word and I'll dig in.
